items.information: ¡Formá parte de este nuevo torneo! Recordá que para participar es obligatorio estar familiarizado con el Reglamento de la WCA ¡Te necesitamos para seguir fortaleciendo nuestra comunidad! Involucrate con las diferentes tareas que nos ayudan a un torneo exitoso y agradable para todos, ya sea como juez, runner, scrambler, etc. Te dejamos links para más información a continuación: * [Reglas basicas sobre cómo competir ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8O_iWRGq4K8) * [Manual WCA para competidores](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/es/tutorial.pdf) * [Manual WCA para jueces](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/judge-tutorial/judge-tutorial-es.pdf) Te esperamos :) ______ Be part of this new tournament! Get involved with the different tasks that help us to have a successful and enjoyable tournament for everyone, be it as a judge, runner, scrambler, etc. We leave you links for more information below: * [Basics rules to compete](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) * [WCA competitor tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) * [WCA judging tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/judge-tutorial/judge-tutorial.pdf) See you there :) CLUB DE SPEEDCUBING PARAGUAY Email: speedcubingpy@gmail.com Facebook: /cscpy Instagram: @cscpy

items.name: Minnesota Newcomer Sunday 2024
items.information: This is a very beginner-friendly competition! All are welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaFJjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--51111b9a3e31767ba773023b6b77e41414361d4a/image.png) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greather than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **This competition is a series competition with [Minnesota Newcomer Saturday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSaturday2024). You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.** [Please click here for more information about series competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSunday2024#34017-series-competitions-faq) This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaE5jIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2bd2c962584c71cb83666f3f9263bbf13f251bb9/image.png) We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.name: Orange County Newcomers 2024
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OrangeCountyNewcomers2024#37502-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbnhmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7ba00c92956d73843dac03263db2d54fe08848f8/image.png) This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. Please refer to the [WCA Newcomer Month Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OrangeCountyNewcomers2024#38166-wca-newcomer-month-information) tab for more information. ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png)
